basic_info.description: Step into refined elegance with this stunning condo located in prestigious Pacific Heights. Boasting 3 beds, 2 baths, and rich Victorian character thoughtfully modernized for today's lifestyle, this residence exemplifies the perfect blend of historic appointments and luxury. Flooded with sunlight and soaring with charm, this two-level condo occupying the top two floors blends timeless architectural details with all the comforts of luxury living. The chef's kitchen features marble counters, custom cabinetry, high-end appliances, and a wine fridge. A formal living room with a fireplace sets the tone for cozy evenings or stylish gatherings.The main level includes a spacious bedroom with dual closets and an elegant marble-clad bath. Upstairs, 2 tranquil bedrooms, an updated bath, and in-unit laundry create a serene retreat. 2-Car parking plus extra storage round out the perks. Located just moments from Union St, Fillmore St, Polk St and Allyne Park, this home delivers the vibrant lifestyle San Francisco dreams are made ofwithout sacrificing privacy or elegance. Welcome to 2531 Gough Street where your next chapter begins!
